concept: Atlas for Government FedRAMP Moderate and High offerings
summary: Source-anchored research for Atlas for Government FedRAMP Moderate and High offerings. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Fed Gov Today’s interview article attributes to MongoDB Principal Technologist Devin Dickerson the description of Atlas for Government FedRAMP High authorization as forthcoming. The article is presented by MongoDB and Carahsoft, so its roadmap statement is attributed vendor evidence rather than independent certification evidence. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

MongoDB presents High and IL5 as intended extensions of the Moderate offering for more sensitive, mission-critical workloads. Its announcement says attaining those authorizations will extend Atlas for Government’s capabilities; that future-tense statement does not itself establish a granted High authorization. (medium confidence)

The Oakmont Group’s Federal Tech Podcast article describes Ben Cefalo discussing MongoDB’s effort to serve agencies requiring FedRAMP High capabilities. This interview coverage supports the existence of a High initiative, without establishing that High authorization was awarded. (low confidence)
